Y-F105 20-feature relational model and ablation (diagnostic only; higher parameter cost)

new_transfer_experiment.name: Native streaming causal-record learning on independently sourced unseen event/relationship topologies
new_transfer_experiment.novelty: use at least two new event-stream data families with distinct causal join/reversal/order grammars and longer delayed dependency structure, not a seed, label, arrival order, or signed-role permutation of F62/old source families; independent public full-stream evaluator establishes task identifiability
new_transfer_experiment.source_birth: freeze source code, event grammar, membership and exact source hashes before any model candidate fitting or first use; independent auditor certifies non-overlap by canonical graph topology and causal-query shape; requires actual new source

budget.model_parameters_and_transient_memory: count weights, action enumeration scratch, frontier and scorer; reallocate within or prove total <= F60 process/worker budget
budget.CPU: median AND p95 model+action CPU no greater than matched F60 fixed native on identical hardware and traces
budget.memory: peak RSS and total retained + learned weights <= strongest matched fixed control (no 144B payload-only proof)

frozen_acceptance.improvement: on EACH independently controlled new structural family >= 8 net additional terminal correct cases out of 128 vs strongest eligible equal-or-lower-resource baseline
frozen_acceptance.statistical: paired one-sided exact McNemar p<0.05 in each replication (family correction preregistered)
frozen_acceptance.positive_preservation: zero loss on originally F60-correct frozen causal tasks, including six-/eight-step retained paths; all family classes included
frozen_acceptance.causal_relevance: state-intervention ablation must remove verified transfer benefit; learned parameter shuffle and replay controls must lose gain while preserving input information
frozen_acceptance.reproduction: independent native replayer reconstructs exact 144B state and source-only path answers; second disjoint grammar passes with same frozen policy
frozen_acceptance.no_cheats: cannot claim topology novelty from same F62 grammar permutations or compare 20-weight learner to 12-weight fixed at unmatched memory
